traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and listed requirements for 006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION are implemented and verified. The `valid-story-reference` ESLint rule enforces that @story annotations reference existing .story.md files, respects configurable story directories and options, uses `context.cwd` with a safe fallback, enforces project boundaries and security constraints, and handles filesystem errors gracefully via dedicated diagnostics. Comprehensive Jest tests cover existence checks, extension validation, path resolution, security/path traversal, project-boundary enforcement, configurable behavior, and filesystem error handling. Rule documentation aligns with the story and explains path resolution and configuration. Although the Implementation Notes mention fs/promises, those notes are optional guidance; the chosen synchronous fs approach still meets all functional, safety, and performance-related requirements with caching and robust error handling. Therefore the story is fully satisfied.
